devices.name: NZXT Control Hub
limitations: Discovery is restricted to liquidctl ControlHub and the exact USB product; other liquidctl drivers are not enabled.
Firmware is included in the live binding; no claim is made that all firmware revisions are certified.
Reported duty and RPM do not establish a safe minimum for an attached fan. Each endpoint requires setup.
The encoder sends 24 uniform pixels per lighting endpoint. LED counts and accessories require explicit confirmation.
Lighting has no color readback. Exit sends the configured color or off; it cannot restore an unknown original effect.
Lighting masks include the instance-local liquidctl 6227bbf correction. Fan masks are unchanged.
Frame timing is a software budget, not a measurement of physical illumination timing.
